title: Enhance home page with dynamic product displays and add Shop Details admin section

requirements.text: Redesign the Marketplace home page (frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx) to display dynamic product sections including: featured products, most viewed products, most sold products, and newest designs. The page should automatically reflect newly uploaded products when customers visit without requiring manual refresh.

quotes: auto refresh home page with info about products
show featured products, most viewed products, and most sold, newest designs

acceptanceCriteria: Home page displays a 'Featured Products' section with product cards
Home page displays a 'Most Viewed Products' section with product cards
Home page displays a 'Best Sellers' section showing most sold products
Home page displays a 'Newest Designs' section showing recently added products
Newly uploaded products appear in the appropriate sections when customers visit the home page
Each product section shows product images, names, and prices with links to detail view

requirements.text: Add backend methods to support home page product displays: getMostViewedProducts(), getBestSellingProducts(), and getNewestProducts(). Implement view tracking for products and sales tracking to support these queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides getMostViewedProducts() method returning products sorted by view count
Backend provides getBestSellingProducts() method returning products sorted by total sales
Backend provides getNewestProducts() method returning products sorted by creation date descending
Product view count is tracked and persisted when products are viewed
Product sales count is tracked and persisted when purchases are completed

requirements.text: Update the Marketplace home page hero section with a new background and motto text about selling original handcrafted products designed, produced, and sold by the trader. Include promotional elements to attract buyers.

quotes: make something up that has to do with selling original products designed, produced and sold by me

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section displays a new background design with warm, artisan-appropriate colors
Hero section includes a compelling motto about original handcrafted products
Hero section includes promotional text encouraging buyers to explore unique designs
Visual design is cohesive with the existing artisan marketplace aesthetic

requirements.text: Create a new 'Shop Details' section in the admin Dashboard page (frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx) as a separate tab where the trader can configure contact email address.

quotes: contact details to send email, setup for this i can find in profile settings shop details

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard page includes a new 'Shop Details' tab alongside existing tabs
Shop Details tab contains a form with an email input field
Form includes a save button to persist shop contact details
Success/error feedback is displayed when saving shop details
Configured email is loaded and displayed when the tab is opened

requirements.text: Add backend data structure and methods to store and retrieve shop contact details including contact email. Create getShopDetails() and updateShopDetails() methods with admin authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores shop details configuration including contact email
Backend provides getShopDetails() method to retrieve current shop details
Backend provides updateShopDetails() method with admin-only access control
Shop details persist across canister upgrades
Empty/default shop details are returned when no configuration exists

requirements.text: Create React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for fetching shop details (useShopDetails) and updating shop details (useUpdateShopDetails) with admin authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: useShopDetails hook fetches current shop details from backend
useUpdateShopDetails mutation hook updates shop details with admin authentication
Query cache is invalidated after successful shop details updates
Hooks handle loading and error states appropriately

requirements.text: Update the Footer component (frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx) to display the configured contact email from Shop Details as a mailto link in the 'Connect' section. Show 'Contact: email@example.com' or similar label.

quotes: at the footer it says connect, make this show contact details to send email

acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays contact email retrieved from shop details configuration
Email is rendered as a clickable mailto link
Contact section shows a label like 'Contact:' or 'Email:' before the email address
If no email is configured, the contact section is hidden or shows placeholder text
Clicking the mailto link opens the user's default email client

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or useInternetIdentity.tsx
Preserve existing Stripe checkout integration flow
Keep existing product management and bulk upload functionality intact
nonGoals: Implementing real-time websocket updates for home page
Adding product filtering or search functionality
Creating separate shop details management outside admin dashboard

required: Hero background image with warm artisan marketplace aesthetic featuring handcrafted items and creative workspace (hero-background.dim_1920x600.png)
